title: Add Roon Discovery dissector
description:
Add support for Roon/roonlabs.com discovery running
on UDP/9003.

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7000/diffs?diff_id=400670753&start_sha=77c877e6b7d5ec05a2bbd9677eb1b142bc935d02)
Can so many if-else branches be optimized through table lookup?

Apologies if I've missed something obvious... been well over a decade since I've written any C.

I've dug through the docs and some other dissectors and haven't found any obvious solution, but does Wireshark have a hash table implementation that supports strings as keys I can use?  Or is this something I'll need to roll my own?

Unfortunately, this protocol uses strings for it's type field, instead of a more typical TLV struct so a simple integer table lookup doesn't seem possible without resorting to effectively the same logic.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7000/diffs?diff_id=409625418&start_sha=92482e27b07a17ba32cc05e0c2509e06de8996d9#512d386e10e9a98c0a628bc089663ec6813bbe55_135_234)

Hi @easonweii,

So I modified the code to use a table and perform lookups... not sure if that's what you had in mind?  For now those changes are a separate commit in case I went the wrong direction.  Happy to squash the two commits if this is more to your liking.
